research_question: Which causally observable low-volume setup can exceed 50 signals per development year, 4% mean net return per completed signal, and remain below 15 trading sessions mean holding time?
economic_hypothesis: Low volume is only the background state: ownership and supply first become quiet inside a bounded inventory range. The tradable edge appears when fresh demand accepts a non-limit information gap and a high-location, volume-expanded breakout. The edge is strongest in a broadly positive but not overheated market and when the stock has not already produced too many large up days.

universe.exclusion_provenance: Inherited unchanged from the registered upstream comparable-daily asset used to freeze the mother candidate identity; this is a data-universe contract, not an outcome-selected industry filter.

frozen_signal.required_history: The last 60 completed same-symbol sessions through signal t are hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid and corporate-action-valid; unknown required lineage fails closed.

quiet_inventory.turnover_contraction: mean turnover over t-20..t-1 <= mean turnover over t-60..t-21

causal_market_filter.bull_definition: At the completed signal close, the upstream comparable-daily universe cross-sectional coordinate-return medians over both 20 and 60 sessions are > 0 and positive-return shares over both horizons are > 0.50.
causal_market_filter.interpretation: Broad participation must be positive, but the 60-session median market advance must not yet be euphoric.

non_overextension_filter.window: 121 completed rows from t-120 through signal t, using only information available at the signal close

frozen_execution.entry: first legal executable open strictly after completed signal t, no later than t+3 market sessions

neighbor_sensitivity.description: Nearby market lower bounds 2%-3%, upper bounds 16%-20%, and large-up-day caps 8-10 generally retain approximately 4.7%-5.3% mean net return with approximately 12.2-12.4 session mean holding time; the frozen rule keeps a frequency buffer above 50 signals per year.

chart_review.window: 126 trading sessions before and 126 trading sessions after each signal
chart_review.summary: Winners usually show prolonged turnover contraction followed by the first accepted gap-and-breakout with clean follow-through. Losers cluster in repeated or late impulses, stale breakouts, broad-market rollover, or euphoria near a market peak.

chip_review.summary: The setup remains profitable across broad chip-state quartiles. It is strongest when price is accepting or reclaiming the upper cost band near P90 with moderate profit migration and retained base inventory; an extreme one-step jump in profitable holders is weaker and resembles chasing.
chip_review.reason: No stable monotonic threshold was found and chip coverage begins only in 2018, so chip state is retained as an explanation and diagnostic rather than a fitted gate.

industry_review.summary: Positive industry breadth supports the interpretation but majority/leader hard filters did not materially improve mean return and reduced coverage.

pre_outcome_validation_identity_audit.purpose: Make the 2024 generator reproduce the already frozen mother-candidate data universe.
pre_outcome_validation_identity_audit.finding: The upstream comparable-daily asset carries 22 causal-industry exclusions that were implicit in the mother candidate identity but omitted from the prose mother contract.
pre_outcome_validation_identity_audit.action: The inherited exclusions were recorded explicitly; no return, exit, or 2022-2024 outcome was inspected and no fitted threshold changed.
pre_outcome_validation_identity_audit.2023_identity_result: After applying the inherited universe, the exact 2022+ PIT reconstruction has one extra 2023 row whose inclusive 1% opening-gap boundary differs by 8.67e-18, and misses two frozen rows whose strict close-above-prior-high comparison differs by 4.44e-16. These are floating-point boundary cases. The 2024 generator retains the literal frozen comparisons and does not add a tolerance.
